title: St. Johns' guide written again from its research brief (gate 3, E.1)
why: 0181 §1 gate 3 and its C7 note: guides publish themselves at 70, and the Editorial lane raises the pilot zone's drafts that are under 70. 0131: St. Johns before live. The Greater St. Johns Area's guide (cluster:1) is a draft scoring about 51 (live read, 2026-11-27: Claude's confidence 55, no research brief, 12 things to check). All its sections are written, so a redraft adds nothing (Guides.php:1097). The existing route is draft_info.renew, the field the guide check itself sets (Guides.php:709): the guide job writes Claude's own sections again with a fresh research brief (Guides.php:802, :1088), keeping any a person wrote. Its cost comes from the AI cap like any renewal, and is recorded on its ticket. Ordered by the session manager (for the PM (8)), after W15 r1.

changes.what: The St. Johns guide is rewritten by the next guide job, with a research brief; if its score reaches 70 it publishes itself, else it stays a draft for the Editorial lane

data_reason: Updates one row of place_guides (cluster:1): adds draft_info.renew so the guide job writes Claude's own sections again. Only when it's a draft, finished, not marked kept, and not already waiting. No other field or row changes. Undo: remove draft_info.renew before the guide job runs. Once it has run, the rewritten sections stand (a person's sections are never touched).
